Hi there,

Happy to help you get your coworker set up! Here's how to invite them as an Editor:

1. Log in to your Loopwise workspace and click your workspace name in the top-left corner.
2. Select "Workspace Settings," then go to the "Members" tab.
3. Click "Invite Member."
4. Enter your coworker's email address.
5. In the role dropdown, select "Editor."
6. Click "Send Invite."

Your coworker will receive an email invitation. Once they accept and create or log in to their account, they'll have Editor access to your workspace, meaning they can create and update projects and tasks but won't have admin permissions like billing or member management.

Note: You'll need to be a workspace Admin or Owner to send invites. If you don't see the "Invite Member" option, an admin on your team will need to do this for you.

Let me know if you run into any issues or have other questions — happy to help!

Best,
Loopwise Support
